description: One named competition's applications must not open or close the general performances slot. Modeled on calfurry, where "Dance Competition applications" set the performances category even though the con runs broader performance signups.

posts.text: Think you've got the moves? Dance Competition applications are open now through September 5th! Performer and variety show signups will be announced separately.

expect_absent.reason: September 5th closes one named competition's applications, not the con's general performance/variety signups (announced separately)
the "open now" is the named Dance Competition only; general performance signups are explicitly still to come
